papers.title: Uniform real-rootedness of the (132,213)-avoiding permutation-polytope family
papers.scope: The result concerns only the specified pattern-avoiding family. Dimensions at most 1000 use de Castro's cited finite theorem. The new all-large-dimension argument is written mathematics with exact scalar certificates, and is not Lean formalization.

papers.title: A padding proof of a conjectured permanent inequality
papers.scope: This is a short deduction from the cited balanced theorem, not an independent proof of that theorem or a claimed new general permanent inequality. The proof uses no computation and has no Lean formalization.

papers.title: Unbounded normalized cofactor spectra for rank-two Gram matrices
papers.scope: The theorem excludes dimension-independent cofactor-ratio bounds. It does not assert a growth rate or solve Lieb's permanental-dominance conjecture. Positive-definite examples need not remain rank two. No Lean formalization is claimed.

papers.title: Sharp logarithmic growth of permanental cofactor spectra and an optimal rank-two endpoint constant
papers.scope: The real Rayleigh optimum still ranges over complex Hermitian matrices; it is not an optimum restricted to real matrices. These are cofactor spectral statements, not Lieb character dominance or Marcus permanent-of-permanents. The proof is written mathematics with exact auxiliary certificates, not Lean formalization.

papers.title: A sharp Gaussian first-moment inequality for every prescribed mass vector
papers.scope: The inequality uses the mass-dependent label metric from the established perimeter-profile Hessian. It does not assert the false unweighted prescribed-mass simplex conjecture, and does not give the sharp value in fixed lower dimensions. Its full analytic endpoint is a written proof using the published multi-bubble theorem; Lean coverage is partial.
